question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?
rendered: According to the document, the sodium nucleation overpotential for bare Al was 19 mV, and for carbon/Al it was 12 mV. Therefore, the carbon layer reduced the sodium nucleation overpotential by (19-12)/19 = 0.37 or 37% of the bare-Al value.
